meta.name: ets
meta.author: D&X
meta.description:
Important:

This is an addition to the Enhancement Units mod, which modifies several towers, sometimes improving them, then changing the shooting mechanics to create some kind of balance between units and towers.

Please pay attention:

The mod significantly reworks the mechanics of turrets, changes the balance and, in general, can simplify the game without the EU. Don't forget to make a backup in case you don't like the changes that the mod itself makes.

P.S. The mod is made for ALE maps.
